representative_policy: Use existing baseline repetition index 0 (train seed 60000, validation seed 60002, test seed 60004) for the interaction and trajectory panels. Never select the representative from errors or visual quality.
fixed_conditions: N=1000, T=2, dt=0.005, sigma=0.1, sigma_obs=0, true kernel, initial law, fixed weak tests, full ordered pairs, trapezoidal quadrature, 1/sqrt(200) row scaling, raw cyclic LASSO, and independent-validation selection are identical for every dictionary size and repetition.
selection_policy: For each dictionary and repetition, select among the same 60 logarithmic penalties by minimum independent-validation weak residual over converged candidates. Never consult the true kernel or test trajectory. Do not standardize, threshold, refit, or impose a support size.
stopping_rule: Run all 80 new triplets for M=9,33,65 irrespective of intermediate dictionary-size trends. Do not add, remove, or select seeds based on outcomes.
failure_policy: Retain every failed job, unconverged candidate, alpha-grid boundary selection, divergent rollout, and basis-domain excursion. If any planned metric is missing, its all-run mean and interval are null; never average only successful repetitions.
manuscript_instruction: Generate and inspect the three-panel practical-use figure first. Do not edit the manuscript in this stage.
